systems.system: National ID card and Nationality Certificate system
systems.platform: Muhlbauer, named for the Nationality Certificate tender
systems.owner: Directorate of Nationality, Passport and Immigration, Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: 170 registration devices across the country and embassies; over 1 million cards issued as at 2018, after fingerprint deduplication. A civil identity system, not described as a police one

systems.system: Handheld read and verify devices for the national ID card
systems.owner: Directorate of Nationality, Passport and Immigration, Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: About 100 devices, largely at the borders, as at 2018

note: A regional study of national identity systems, read to its end; the South Sudan section covers the identity card and nationality certificate only, and nothing is said of police stations or their records.
